selectionPopulation: Pinned public repository findings emitted by the corrected SiteCMD Code Scan whose expected behavior can be graded locally without network access.
estimand: Within-task differences among normal, report, and MCP workflows for independently gradable issues that the corrected SiteCMD Code Scan detects. This corpus does not estimate scanner recall across all software defects.
selectionMethod: Purposive scanner-enriched selection from public historical repairs and locally provable negative controls. Each exact finding and upstream revision was observed before selection, while no repair-agent outcome was observed. The corpus is frozen before model trials and must pass source, scanner, runtime, and independent behavioral qualification.
limitations: The estimand is conditional on SiteCMD detecting the issue and does not measure scanner recall.
Public fixes may have appeared in model training or retrieval corpora.
The small corpus emphasizes security findings and is not a random sample of repositories.
Recorded exclusions remove only unrelated source trees, documentation, generated reports, or vendored package-manager content. Every omitted Git object and reason is retained in the source receipt.

cases.task: Keep user-controlled agent names and prompts out of command-shell parsing.
cases.requirements: Launch child processes with argument arrays and no command shell. Reject malformed agent names before installation, preserve valid category/name slugs, support Windows command shims, and keep existing task status and output behavior.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports request-to-shell data flow in the sandbox server, and the pinned security repair removes shell execution while preserving the command workflow.

sourceExclusions.reason: The bundled agent and skill catalog is not executed by the sandbox server repair.
The generated security report is not used by the sandbox server runtime.
The separate dashboard application is outside the sandbox server repair.
The generated documentation site is outside the command execution boundary under test.

cases.task: Render search suggestions as text instead of active HTML.
cases.requirements: Suggestion content derived from the query and worker response must remain literal text, including tags and entity-like strings. Preserve ordinary suggestions, spaces, hyphens, right-arrow acceptance, and the existing observable lifecycle.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the exact suggestion innerHTML assignment, and the pinned upstream repair replaces it with text rendering.

sourceExclusions.reason: Authored documentation content is not used by the search suggestion component test.
Built Python package assets duplicate or sit outside the TypeScript source repair under test.

cases.task: Do not combine a wildcard CORS origin with credentialed responses.
cases.requirements: Wildcard origin mode must disable credentials, while an explicit origin allowlist may retain credential support. Preserve configured origin parsing, allowed methods and headers, exposed token headers, and requests without ambient browser credentials.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the wildcard and credentials combination in the FastAPI server, and the pinned upstream repair derives the credential setting from the resolved origins.

sourceExclusions.reason: Documentation assets are not imported by the FastAPI CORS configuration under test.

cases.task: Make Glances reject or neutralize wildcard credentialed CORS configuration.
cases.requirements: The default configuration and an explicit wildcard origin must not enable credentials. Explicit origin allowlists may retain the configured credential behavior. Preserve configurable methods, headers, authentication setup, and the REST API startup path.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports wildcard origins paired with a credential default of true, and the pinned upstream repair defaults credentials off and guards the invalid configured combination.

cases.task: Preserve Python's default HTTPS certificate verification in the Triton model backend.
cases.requirements: Importing the model backend must not replace the process-wide default HTTPS context with an unverified context. Preserve Triton model initialization, inference execution, environment configuration, and preflight diagnostics.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the process-wide unverified HTTPS context assignment, and the pinned upstream repair removes that override without changing model behavior.

cases.task: Create extension custom elements without interpolating route data into HTML.
cases.requirements: Accept only valid custom-element names, construct the element through DOM APIs, and block malformed names without creating markup. Preserve valid extension loading, subroute propagation, extension service injection, navigation reload behavior, and the existing holder element.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the dynamic extension innerHTML assignment, and the pinned upstream repair validates the tag name and uses document.createElement.

cases.task: Review the sandbox server's loopback URLs and change them only if the server is intended for remote deployment.
cases.requirements: The command-executing server must remain bound to loopback and accept browser origins only for its local UI. Preserve both localhost and 127.0.0.1 access on the configured port. A no-op is required when the pinned implementation already enforces this local-only topology.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports fixed loopback URLs, while the same pinned security revision explicitly binds the command server to 127.0.0.1 and uses those URLs as its exact local CORS boundary.
cases.safetyRationale: This is a local developer server that executes commands. It binds to 127.0.0.1, and its localhost URLs enumerate the only browser origins permitted to drive that local process. Replacing them with a deployable remote destination would weaken the intended boundary.

cases.task: Review the entity decoder and change it only if decoded input can create active markup.
cases.requirements: HTML entities must decode to a returned string without inserting parsed nodes into the document. Tags, event attributes, and script-like input must remain inert outside the detached decoder. Preserve named and numeric entity decoding and ordinary text. A no-op is required when the pinned implementation already meets this contract.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports a raw-HTML assignment on a detached textarea, while the function immediately returns only the textarea textContent and never attaches the parsed nodes.
cases.safetyRationale: The textarea exists only as a detached entity decoder. Its parsed children are never appended to the document, and callers receive a plain string from textContent rather than nodes or HTML.

sourceExclusions.reason: The vendored package-manager cache is not source and is not needed by the entity decoder grader.
